title: Batman: Damned — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in Batman: Damned — it is manufactured for it. Batman: Damned is an American comic book series published by DC Comics. The three-issue limited series, written by Brian Azzarello and illustrated by Lee Bermejo, began on September 19, 2018 and concluded on June 26, 2019.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Batman: Damned shows exactly where that breaks. Batman finds Etrigan at the Cavern and fights through the crowd to confront him. Etrigan, angry for being interrupted during a performance, orders the crowd to point firearms at Batman.
